dedupe_keys.name: zineb bdg medical waste management system in a smart city using xai and vehicle routing optimization data initial implementation

description: Zineb-bdg publishes benchmark inputs and results associated with a medical-waste collection study. Although the Zenodo release is labelled software, the inspected GitHub tree mainly lists Solomon routing instances, time-dependent input files, waste-training and test CSVs, and an Excel routing-results table. No README or conventional model source files were returned by the repository listing. The July 2023 archive is freely downloadable with Zenodo terms labelled Other Open; the current GitHub repository states CC0. These materials may support vehicle-routing and bin-fill prediction simulations using capacity and time-window assumptions. The simulations concern site-to-site collection; actual geographic coverage, data-generation method, column definitions and equivalence to the described Simul8 implementation remain unknown. No related catalogue record explicitly includes this bundle. It is classified here as data, without claiming that a complete operational waste-management system is published. Files were not downloaded.
